units.source_text: “我和K并肩走着，心里却等着他接着说下去。

en.t: As I walked side by side with K, in my heart I was waiting for him to go on.

units.source_text: 或许说是‘设下埋伏’更恰当些吧。

en.t: Perhaps it would be more accurate to say that I was lying in wait.

units.source_text: 那时候我甚至想，纵然给他设圈套，也在所不惜。

en.t: At that moment, I even thought I would not mind setting a trap for him.

units.source_text: 不过，我也受过教育，多少有些良心，所以，假设此时有人走到我身边，对我悄悄说一句‘你真卑鄙！’的话，

en.t: Still, I had received an education and had some conscience, so if someone had come up beside me then and whispered, 'How despicable you are!',

units.source_text: 我说不定会在那一瞬间幡然悔悟的。

en.t: I might have come suddenly to my senses at that very instant.

units.source_text: 如果K是那个人的话，我也会在他面前羞愧万分的吧。

en.t: If K had been that person, I would probably have been overwhelmed with shame before him.

units.source_text: 遗憾的是，K实在太正直、太单纯了，他的心地太善良了，因此他绝对不会责备我。

en.t: Unfortunately, K was far too honest and too simple; his heart was too good, and so he would never reproach me.

units.source_text: 昏了头的我，不但忘记了应该对他肃然起敬，反而乘虚而入，

en.t: Blinded as I was, I not only forgot that I ought to respect him solemnly, but instead took advantage of his weakness,

units.source_text: 想要利用他的善良将他击垮。

en.t: and tried to use his goodness to bring him down.

units.source_text: 过了一会儿，K叫了声我的名字，望着我。

en.t: After a while, K called my name and looked at me.

units.source_text: 这次是我不自觉地停下了脚步，于是K也停了下来。

en.t: This time I stopped without realizing it, and K stopped too.

units.source_text: 这时我才和他四目相对，他的个子比我高，我必须仰着脸看他。

en.t: Only then did our eyes meet; he was taller than I was, so I had to look up at his face.

units.source_text: 我的眼睛宛如一只凶恶的狼盯着无辜的羊一般盯着他。

en.t: My eyes fixed on him like a fierce wolf staring at an innocent lamb.
'Let us not talk about this anymore,' he said.

units.source_text: 他的眼神和声音里都隐含着哀痛。

en.t: There was a hidden sorrow in both his eyes and his voice.
For a moment, I found myself unable to answer.

units.source_text: ‘别再说了。’他恳求般地又重复了一遍。

en.t: 'Please stop talking about it,' he repeated, this time almost pleading.

units.source_text: 我那时给了他一个残忍的回答，就如同狼瞅准机会咬住羊的喉管一样。

en.t: At that moment I gave him a cruel reply, like a wolf seizing its chance to bite into a lamb's throat.
